Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

The instant appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 has been filed on behalf of the appellant seeking the following reliefs:
"a) Allow / admit the appeal of the appellant and set aside / modify the judgment /
award dated 25.04.2024 passed by Sh.
Sh. Shivaji Anand , MACT Rohini Court, New Delhi , in the case Titled As Manisha Vs Sanjeev Vide MACT No. 106 / 2022 b) Any other relief which this Hon ' ble Court deems fit and proper , in the facts and circumstances of the present case may also be granted in favour of Appellant and against the Respondents."
Heard.

sentences.text: The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/07/2024 at 05:50:21 Issue notice
Learned counsel for the respondent no. 1 accepted notice.
Issue notice to the remaining respondents through all permissible modes of filing PF within one week.
This Court is of the considered view that the matter requires consideration.

Subject to the appellant's deposition of 100% of the compensation amount along with interest as per judgment/award passed by learned Tribunal dated 25th April, 2024 before the Registrar General of this Court within a period of four weeks, the operation of the impugned judgment/award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.
List on 12th September, 2024 before Joint Registrar (Judicial) for completion of service and pleadings.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J JULY 15, 2024 rk/ryp
